html:
Question 5
A calculator is required to answer the following question.

The concentration of a certain drug, in mg/L, in a patient's bloodstream t hours after being taken is given by the function C(t)=24⋅(0.5)t. Calculate C(3), and determine its meaning in this context.

a
 The concentration of the drug half an hour after being taken is 3mg/L
b
 The concentration of the drug 24 hours after being taken is 3mg/L
c
 The concentration of the drug 3 hours after being taken is 6mg/L
d
 The concentration of the drug 3 hours after being taken is 3mg/L
e
 The concentration of the drug 1 hour after being taken is 3mg/L
